kpis.description_en: Plastics & Devices revenue (auto-injectors, inhalers, drug delivery devices). Gerresheimer's first growth driver led by GLP-1.

kpis.description_en: Adjusted EBITDA margin (currency-adjusted). Gerresheimer's strategic internal target (>22% MT). Weighted 65% in management STI.

kpis_story.description_fr: Acquisition de Bormioli Pharma annoncée 2024 (~800 M €) : renforcement primary packaging pharma, accès marché GLP-1 (Ozempic/Wegovy).
kpis_story.description_en: Bormioli Pharma acquisition announced 2024 (~€800M): strengthened primary pharma packaging, GLP-1 (Ozempic/Wegovy) market access.
